items.title: Nvidia Moves On From Huang as Anthropic IPO Looms
items.title_ko: Nvidia Moves On From Huang as Anthropic IPO Looms
items.summary_ko: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Nvidia's earnings report, with the AI chip giant reassuring investors that Jensen Huang isn't coming back, and that Nvidia will do just fine without him. Plus, all eyes on Anthropic as the AI company is tracking to price its shares above the marketed range in its IPO, and Grand Theft Auto VI becomes the best-reviewed game of all time ahead of its release tomorrow.

KeyBanc Capital Markets Managing Director John Vinh discusses the CEO search, talent risks and Nvidia’s push to secure more AI chip capacity with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
